name: V8 DEMO ONLY · short / partial / tail

author.name: Codex diagnostics
author.prompt: Owner-started ordinary OKX Demo execution probe. Not an author strategy or profitability test.

description: Demo-only operating procedure: short, partial reduction window, residual after admission cutoff, authored exit. Keep as an unpromoted draft.
original_text: In the owner's OKX Demo workshop, allocate100 USDT and admit entries for300 seconds. With fresh known data and spread <=1.5bps, ask the normal Jev entry veto for one short of30% allocation, rounded down to the actual exchange lot. A veto remains a veto. No adds. With actual position age >=120 and <180 seconds, reduce50% of the then-owned contracts, rounded down, at most once per position/bar; keep the residual. Depending on fill time relative to the minute boundary, this window may admit two partial actions on different bars. Do not force a partial if it is below the lot. Continue management after the admission cutoff, with no new entries/adds. At a new completed minute with position age >=420 seconds, fully reduce the owned remainder. Max hold is null; SL200bps, TP600bps and ownerStop/risk/recovery retain priority. This is a diagnostic demo probe, not evidence of profit and not a strategy for the Live arena. Root does not freeze or promote it.
